strongest_angle: Examine the technical failure and orbital decay forcing NASA to conclude the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory mission after 21 years, following a failed commercial rescue attempt and leading to an imminent atmospheric reentry.

key_facts.fact: NASA concluded the science mission of the Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory as it orbits less than 171 miles (275 kilometers) above Earth's surface.
The Neil Gehrels Swift Observatory conducted its final observation on October 20, 2026, after launching in November 2004.
NASA shut down the astronomy spacecraft in a decaying orbit after a failed attempt to reboost it using a commercial spacecraft.
